title: Dissecting emotional and cardiac contributions to duration perception: Evidence from two EEG experiments.
summary: Time perception is inherently malleable, influenced by both emotional and bodily states. Past research suggests that transient heartbeat-linked interoceptive signals can modulate time perception, with some studies reporting that brief stimuli presented during cardiac systole are perceived as shorter than those during diastole. Here, we used electroencephalography (EEG) across two experiments to examine how such cardiac-phase effects are neurally instantiated, and how they interact with emotional content of the stimuli. In Experiment 1, participants judged the duration of brief neutral visual stimuli (Gabor patches) presented during systole or diastole. We did not observe a reliable group-level behavioural cardiac-phase effect. Despite that, EEG revealed systolic modulation of late visual activity. Crucially, exploratory analyses showed that more negative late cortical activity predicted temporal underestimation only during systole, not diastole. In Experiment 2, we extended this design to emotionally salient stimuli (neutral vs fearful faces). Fearful faces were perceived as shorter in duration and accompanied by enhanced N170-like negativity compared to neutral faces. But this effect was not modulated by cardiac phase, suggesting that emotional salience is a much more powerful driver of duration perception than subtle cardiac fluctuations. Yet, even for faces, enhanced EEG negativity predicted temporal contraction only during systole. Together, these findings reveal that while group-level behavioural cardiac-phase effects are variable, the systole-specific neural mechanism, whereby reduced cortical activity predicts temporal contraction, replicated across both experiments. This suggests that cardiac signals can shape duration perception through transient modulation of cortical processing.

标题：解析情绪与心脏活动对时长感知的贡献：来自两项EEG实验的证据
摘要：时间感知本质上是可塑的，受到情绪状态和身体状态的影响。以往研究表明，与心跳相关的短暂内感受信号可以调节时间感知，一些研究报告称，在心脏收缩期呈现的短暂刺激比在舒张期呈现的刺激被感知为更短。本研究通过两项脑电图（EEG）实验，考察这种心脏相位效应如何在神经层面得以实现，以及它如何与刺激的情绪内容发生交互。实验1中，被试判断在收缩期或舒张期呈现的短暂中性视觉刺激（Gabor斑块）的持续时间。我们未观察到可靠的群体水平行为学心脏相位效应。尽管如此，EEG揭示了收缩期对晚期视觉活动的调节。关键的是，探索性分析显示，更负的晚期皮层活动仅在收缩期预测时间低估，而在舒张期则不然。实验2中，我们将该设计扩展至情绪显著性刺激（中性面孔与恐惧面孔）。与中性面孔相比，恐惧面孔被感知为持续时间更短，并伴随增强的类N170负波。但这一效应并未受到心脏相位的调节，提示情绪显著性对时长感知的驱动作用远强于细微的心脏波动。然而，即便对于面孔，增强的EEG负波也仅在收缩期预测时间收缩。总之，这些发现表明，尽管群体水平的行为学心脏相位效应存在变异，但收缩期特异性的神经机制——即皮层活动降低预测时间收缩——在两项实验中均得到重复验证。这提示心脏信号可能通过短暂调节皮层加工来塑造时长感知。
关键词：时间感知；心脏相位；脑电图；情绪显著性；恐惧面孔

title: Neural dynamics of racial categorization of faces in Black Africans residing in China.
summary: While recent research has revealed earlier neural-based racial categorization of other-race compared to same-race faces in White and Asian samples, neural dynamics underlying racial categorization in Black Africans remain unclear. We recorded electroencephalography (EEG) from Black adults from African countries and residing in China who performed an individual identification task on faces presented in repetition (faces of one racial category shown repeatedly) or alternating (other-race and same-race faces alternated) conditions, respectively. Racial categorization was assessed by quantifying repetition suppression (RS) of neural responses to faces across these two conditions. We found RS for both phase (the P2 amplitudes) and non-phase-locked (theta band, 3-8 Hz) responses to Black (but not Asian or White) faces. This neural profile was consistent with participants' faster responses to Black than White/Asian faces in an explicit racial categorization task. Furthermore, the theta-band RS effect predicted implicit negative attitudes toward Black faces across the participants. These results indicate earlier categorization of same-race (vs. other-race) faces in Black Africans residing in China, contrasting with the other-race priority in race categorization of faces observed in Asian and White samples.

标题：居住在中国的非洲黑人对面孔种族分类的神经动力学
摘要：尽管近期研究已表明白人和亚洲样本中对其他种族面孔的神经种族分类早于同种族面孔，但非洲黑人进行种族分类时的神经动力学仍不清楚。我们记录了来自非洲国家并居住在中国的非洲黑人成人的脑电图（EEG），他们分别对重复呈现（同一类种族面孔反复呈现）或交替呈现（其他种族和同种族面孔交替呈现）条件下的面孔执行个体识别任务。通过量化这两种条件下面孔神经反应的重复抑制（RS）来评估种族分类。我们发现，对黑人（而非亚洲人或白人）面孔的相位（P2波幅）和非相位锁定（theta频段，3-8 Hz）反应均出现RS。这一神经特征与参与者在显性种族分类任务中对黑人面孔比白人/亚洲面孔反应更快相一致。此外，theta频段RS效应预测了参与者对黑人面孔的内隐消极态度。这些结果表明，居住在中国的非洲黑人对同种族（相对于其他种族）面孔的分类更早，这与亚洲和白人样本中观察到的面孔种族分类的其他种族优先效应形成对比。
关键词：种族分类；面孔加工；脑电图；重复抑制；内隐态度

title: Shared and culture-specific brain networks for emotional facial discrimination: Evidence from predictive modeling.
summary: Whether emotional facial expressions are perceived universally or are culture-specific has been a topic of debate in affective neuroscience. To address this, we employed connectome-based predictive modeling (CPM) to analyse whole-brain connectivity data from an emotional face discrimination task, examining cultural influences on emotional facial perception in White Americans and Han Chinese. We demonstrated that individual differences in emotional facial discrimination could be predicted in both groups. However, there was limited overlap in the network predictors between groups, with the motor regions, inferior semi-lunar lobule, and culmen emerging as shared hubs at both the network and node levels. Group-specific patterns were also observed. In the Chinese group, unique predictive nodes included the inferior occipital gyrus, cingulate gyrus, and cerebellar tonsil, with dominant contributions arising from cerebellar-motor interactions. In contrast, the White American group showed distinct involvement of the superior temporal gyrus, nodule, and culmen, with primary predictive contributions driven by the motor network. Notably, the predictive model trained on White Americans showed success in generalizing to Han Chinese individuals, whereas the reverse was not observed. These differences may reflect cultural differences in the functional relevance of core predictive networks. Classification analyses validated the functional importance of CPM-identified nodes, showing that activity in these regions distinguished cultural groups in their responses to emotional faces and baseline conditions. These findings offer unique insights into the neural mechanisms by which culture influences emotional facial perception, underscoring the importance of predictive modeling in cultural neuroscience.
translation:
相关性：是
标题：情绪面孔识别的共享与 culture-specific 脑网络：来自预测建模的证据
摘要：情绪面孔表情的感知是普遍性的还是文化特异性的，一直是情感神经科学领域争论的话题。为解决这一问题，我们采用基于连接组的预测建模（CPM）分析情绪面孔识别任务的全脑连接数据，考察文化对 White Americans 和 Han Chinese 情绪面孔感知的影响。我们证明，在两组人群中均可预测情绪面孔识别的个体差异。然而，两组之间的网络预测因子重叠有限，其中运动区域、下半月小叶和山顶在网络和节点水平上均为共享枢纽。同时也观察到 group-specific 模式。在中国组中，独特的预测节点包括枕下回、扣带回和小脑扁桃体，其主要贡献来自小脑-运动交互。相比之下，White American 组表现出颞上回、小结和山顶的独特参与，其主要预测贡献由运动网络驱动。值得注意的是，在 White Americans 上训练的预测模型能够成功泛化到 Han Chinese 个体，而反向则未观察到。这些差异可能反映了核心预测网络功能相关性的文化差异。分类分析验证了 CPM 识别节点的功能重要性，表明这些区域的活动能够区分不同文化群体对情绪面孔和基线条件的反应。这些发现为文化影响情绪面孔感知的神经机制提供了独特见解，凸显了预测建模在文化神经科学中的重要性。
关键词：情绪面孔识别；文化神经科学；基于连接组的预测建模；全脑连接；面孔感知

title: Exploring the experiences of autistic and non-autistic aphantasics: A qualitative study.
summary: Visual imagery - the creation of images mentally without the corresponding sensory input - plays an important role in multiple cognitive processes. The lack of conscious visual imagery, known as aphantasia, has been linked to autistic traits. However, there is a lack of qualitative studies exploring the experiences of aphantasics, autistic or non-autistic. The current study aimed to investigate the experiences of autistic and non-autistic aphantasics qualitatively, exploring possible similarities and differences that might shed light on links or differential mechanisms. Qualitative framework analysis and quantifying methods were used to analyse data collected via an online survey. A total of 25 aphantasic adults with a clinical diagnosis of autism, and 25 age-matched non-autistic aphantasic comparison participants, completed a series of questionnaires and an open-ended question, providing data for the current analyses. Three themes were identified, each with four subthemes: imagery (auditory and other sensory imagery, inner speech, spatial and navigation, dreams), thinking (abstract thinking, thinking in words, creativity, memory), and emotions and socialization (own emotions, others' emotions, social relationship, feeling different). Significantly more non-autistic than autistic participants endorsed the subtheme concerning "auditory and other sensory imagery", while the opposite was the case for the subtheme "verbal thinking". This is the first study to explore the lived experience of autistic and non-autistic aphantasic adults through qualitative methods. We hope to promote wider public understanding and appreciation of the different, but certainly not deficient, experiences of aphantasia and its intersection with autism.
translation:
相关性：是
标题：探索自闭症与非自闭症心盲症者的体验：一项质性研究
摘要：视觉意象——即在没有相应感官输入的情况下在心理上创造图像——在多种认知过程中发挥着重要作用。缺乏有意识的视觉意象，即心盲症，已被发现与自闭症特质相关。然而，目前缺乏探索心盲症者（无论是否自闭症）体验的质性研究。本研究旨在质性探究自闭症与非自闭症心盲症者的体验，探讨可能揭示二者联系或差异机制的相似性与差异。研究采用质性框架分析和量化方法，对通过在线调查收集的数据进行分析。共25名经临床诊断为自闭症的心盲症成人，以及25名年龄匹配的非自闭症心盲症对照参与者，完成了一系列问卷和一个开放性问题，为本研究分析提供了数据。研究识别出三个主题，每个主题包含四个子主题：意象（听觉及其他感官意象、内部言语、空间与导航、梦境）、思维（抽象思维、以词语思考、创造力、记忆），以及情绪与社交（自身情绪、他人情绪、社会关系、感到不同）。非自闭症参与者中认同“听觉及其他感官意象”子主题的人数显著多于自闭症参与者，而“言语思维”子主题则呈现相反模式。这是首项通过质性方法探索自闭症与非自闭症心盲症成人生活体验的研究。我们希望促进公众更广泛地理解和认识心盲症及其与自闭症交叉的不同但绝非缺陷的体验。
关键词：心盲症；自闭症；视觉意象；质性研究；情绪与社交

title: Seeing is believing: mental imagery amplifies moral, emotional, and motivational responding to mentally constructed hypothetical events.
summary: Mental imagery is theorised to support important mental simulation processes, yet there remains little direct evidence of its functional impact on affective, moral, and motivation outcomes. This study examined whether the ability to generate visual mental imagery amplifies "as-if-real" responding to a mentally constructed harm event. Using a modified laboratory harm provocation paradigm, Aphantasics (individuals with no or minimal visual imagery; N = 32) and Visualisers (those with normal to high imagery ability; N = 48) were asked to write down the sentence "I hope [name of a loved one] is in a car accident", followed by instructed mental simulation of the event. The Aphantasic group reported significantly lower anxiety, guilt, moral violation, sense of responsibility and control, as well as urge to neutralise (cancel) the effects the sentence relative to the Visualiser group, but similar perceptions of event likelihood and severity. While Aphantasics were also less likely to engage in neutralisation behaviour than Visualisers, this effect reflected baseline group differences in age and thought-action fusion beliefs. Mental imagery ratings and episodic detail reports confirmed that visualisers generated more vivid and detailed representations of the imagined event. These findings support emulation theory by demonstrating that scene-based mental imagery makes mental events more real, eliciting greater "as-if-real" response. Results have implications for understanding the cognitive mechanisms involved in the development of obsessions and obsessive-compulsive symptoms, and suggest that aphantasia may confer reduced vulnerability to such responses.
translation:
相关性：是
标题：眼见为实：心理意象放大了对心理建构的假设性事件的道德、情绪和动机反应
摘要：心理意象被理论认为支持重要的心理模拟过程，但其对情感、道德和动机结果的功能性影响仍缺乏直接证据。本研究考察了生成视觉心理意象的能力是否会放大对心理建构的伤害事件的“如同真实”反应。研究采用改良的实验室伤害挑衅范式，将心盲症者（无或极少视觉意象的个体；N=32）与视觉意象者（正常至高意象能力的个体；N=48）进行对比，要求被试写下“我希望[所爱之人的名字]遭遇车祸”这句话，随后按照指导对该事件进行心理模拟。相较于视觉意象者组，心盲症组报告了显著更低的焦虑、内疚、道德违犯感、责任感和控制感，以及中和（取消）该句子效果的冲动，但两组对事件发生可能性和严重性的感知相似。虽然心盲症者从事中和行为的可能性也低于视觉意象者，但这一效应反映了两组在年龄和思维-行动融合信念上的基线差异。心理意象评分和情景细节报告证实，视觉意象者对想象事件生成了更生动、更详细的表征。这些发现支持了仿真理论，表明基于场景的心理意象使心理事件更加真实，从而引发更强的“如同真实”反应。研究结果有助于理解强迫观念和强迫症状发展所涉及的认知机制，并提示心盲症可能降低此类反应的易感性。
关键词：心理意象；心盲症；道德情绪；思维-行动融合；强迫症状

title: Depression and Perceived Social Support among Unemployed Youths in China: Investigating the Roles of Emotion-Regulation Difficulties and Self-Efficacy
summary: In recent years, the issue of youth unemployment has begun to emerge in China. Unemployed young people are at high risk of depression and other mental health problems. The present study investigates influential factors related to depression and examines the possible mediating effects of difficulties in emotion regulation and self-efficacy between perceived social support and depressive symptoms among unemployed youths in China. Through community recruitment, 511 unemployed young people from Shanghai participated in this cross-sectional survey. The results demonstrate that the prevalence of probable depression in the sample was 49.3% (95% CI: 45.0–53.7%). Moreover, we found that both the perceived social support and self-efficacy were significant negative predictors of depression, whereas difficulties in emotion regulation were positive predictors of depression. In addition, the analysis results indicate that difficulties in emotion regulation and self-efficacy partially mediate the relationship between perceived social support and depression. Overall, this cross-sectional study reveals that depression and mental health problems among China’s unemployed youths are concerning while identifying emotion-regulation difficulties as a risk factor for these and social support and self-efficacy as protective factors, all of which warrant our attention in preventing and intervening with cases of youth depression.

相关性：是
标题：中国失业青年的抑郁与感知社会支持：情绪调节困难与自我效能感的作用考察
摘要：近年来，青年失业问题在中国开始凸显。失业青年面临抑郁及其他心理健康问题的高风险。本研究考察了与抑郁相关的影响因素，并检验了情绪调节困难与自我效能感在中国失业青年感知社会支持与抑郁症状之间的可能中介效应。通过社区招募，来自上海的511名失业青年参与了这项横断面调查。结果表明，样本中可能抑郁的患病率为49.3%（95% CI：45.0–53.7%）。此外，我们发现感知社会支持和自我效能感均为抑郁的显著负向预测因素，而情绪调节困难则为抑郁的正向预测因素。分析结果还表明，情绪调节困难与自我效能感在感知社会支持与抑郁之间起部分中介作用。总体而言，这项横断面研究揭示，中国失业青年的抑郁与心理健康问题令人担忧，同时将情绪调节困难识别为这些问题的风险因素，将社会支持与自我效能感识别为保护因素，这些均值得我们在预防和干预青年抑郁时予以关注。
关键词：失业青年；抑郁；感知社会支持；情绪调节困难；自我效能感
